eucharistic adoration: eucharistic adoration takes place every monday morning after the 10.00 a.m. mass except on bank holiday mondays. all saints day: this sunday is the feast of all saints and mass will be at the usual times – saturday evening 5.30 p.m. (vigil),9.15 a.m. & 11.00 a.m. feast of all souls: monday 2nd november is the commemoration of all the faithful departed and mass will be at the usual time of 10.00 a.m. first friday : next friday, 6th november is the first friday of the month and confessions will be heard on thursday morning after the 10.00 a.m. mass st. vincent de paul: the society of st. vincent de paul will hold their usual monthly church gate collection next weekend 7th /8th november. altar list of the dead: mass will be offered during the month of november and on the first friday of every month for all those whose names are on the altar list of the dead. envelopes have been delivered to all household in the parish and there are also spare envelopes available at the back of the church. envelopes with the names of your deceased loved ones may be placed in the safes at the back of the church or handed into the sacristy for inclusion. month of the holy souls – special mass: a special mass will be celebrated on friday 20th november at 7.30 p.m. for all parishioners who died over the past year, for all our deceased relatives and friends and for all the holy souls. all are welcome to attend. children's christmas choir: children's christmas choir will commence rehearsals on friday 6 nov in the church from 3-4pm. the choir sings at the carol service and christmas eve family mass. for enquiries, please contact bern hennessey on

or leave a message in the sacristy. ‘koins for kids’ : all coins and notes old, new, damaged including non- euro currency will be gratefully accepted and can be dropped into the sacristy. full details on church notice board.

‘tap to pay’ – reminder: tap to pay is available at the back of the church if you would like to contribute towards the necessary funds for the continued maintenance and upkeep of our parish church and grounds - your contributions will go exclusively to the running costs of our parish. church shop/repository: the church repository/shop is open every tuesday and thursday morning after 10.00 a.m. mass and after 11.00 a.m. mass on sundays. a good selection of items is available. please pay us a visit. christmas party for the sick & housebound : the marino unit of the order of malta ambulance corps would like to thank the residents of marino, fairview and drumcondra for their continued support of our christmas party for the sick & housebound. the event which has been running for almost 46 years is a very special occasion and loved by all those who attend. this year the party will be on the 29th november in le cheile community centre, donnycarney. invites will be issued shortly but if you know of anyone who would like to attend, please do contact maria maguire at

or (01) 8376722 (after 5.00 to support this event, we will be holding a church gate collection on the 14th & 15th november. your support on the day would be very welcome. mass intentions: we include up to 5 mass intentions in the announcements at week-end masses (saturday evening and sunday morning). mass intentions should be notified to the sacristy for inclusion at least 3 months in advance to avoid disappointment. material for weekly bulletin: please note all material for publication in the weekly bulletin must reach the parish ofoce by 10.00 a.m. on thursday morning. thank you for your co-operation. a month with our friends the souls in purgatory: there is now a book available in our parish shop called ‘a month with our friends the souls in purgatory’ – this book contains a 30 day novena which includes prayers to obtain release from purgatory for suffering souls. if you would like a copy, please call in.
share appeal sunday takes place next weekend , november 7/8, highlighting the important work that is funded by the weekly collection. share newsletter is available at back of church
